# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

<!-- cap-evolve:framework-improvements-append-below -->

## Iteration cand_0001
- The proposer's local base DB (`get_db()` / AIRLINE_DB_PATH) does NOT match the per-task eval DB states (flight dates, prices, and which reservations exist differ — e.g. NQNU5R is future-dated locally but past-dated in eval task 37; task 25 re-quotes the fare to 375). This forces verification against hand-constructed inputs and leaves date/price-dependent guards partly un-de-risked. SUGGESTION: expose each eval task's initial DB snapshot (read-only) to the proposer, or at least the per-task overrides applied on top of the base DB, so a fix can be verified against the exact state it will be scored on.
- The failing traces include a null-reward task caused by hitting max_steps (task 23). This is indistinguishable from a genuine capability failure without opening the trace. SUGGESTION: tag rollouts that terminated on the step cap / infra error separately from reward-0 capability failures, so proposers don't spend an edit on infra noise.
- Feedback strings truncate the wrong-write argument mid-JSON (e.g. "flights=[{...'HA"), so the specific wrong value is sometimes cut off. SUGGESTION: include the full offending write args (or a structured diff vs gold) rather than a truncated string.
